subject: Sherpa sync: lift plan for exec asks + roadmap exception closes
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Crossfunc Sherpa <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sherpa sync: lift plan for exec asks + roadmap exception closes

Team —

Quick follow-up from Friday's cross-functional sync: NimbusHealth needs a clear "lift" plan tied to the exec asks we promised during the product QBR. They expect milestones, owners, and a go/no-go on three roadmap exceptions by next Friday. I pulled together a single-sheet lift plan (attached) — please review and confirm ownership below.

Summary asks (high priority for exec):
- Security evidence & retention answers (they requested SOC mapping and audit log retention) — due EOD Tue (owned by Olga).
- Dedicated model pin for inference (they want guaranteed model version for cert) — decision and rollout plan by Thu (owned by Karthik).
- Pricing/commit confirmation (they need committed monthly capacity for Dedicated) — draft terms to send by Fri (owned by Marissa + Finance).

Immediate asks:
1) Can owners confirm they can hit those dates (or propose alternative) by EOD Monday?
2) If any exceptions require product trade-offs, flag them in the doc with impact estimates (latency/cost/infra).
3) Sam (external) — please confirm if Nimbus needs any additional compliance artifacts beyond SOC2 and audit logs so we can include in Olga's tracker.

Attachments: Sherpa_Lift_Roadmap.xlsx (master plan), Nimbus_Security_Reqs_Summary.pdf (initial ask packet).

Thanks — short thread only, please.

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sherpa sync: lift plan for exec asks + roadmap exception closes

Tessa — thanks for the crisp asks. Quick ownership confirmations from my side:
- Pricing/commit draft: I’ll own the first draft and coordinate Finance. Target: Friday COB (2027-05-14). I’ll include two commitment tiers and a short fallback (monthly burst cap).
- I synced with Finance yesterday — we should be able to present a committed-Dedicated option plus a transition plan to Dedicated in 30 days. I’ll flag any terms that require an SLA exception.

Action items I’m taking now:
- Prepare pricing tiers + recommended SLA language (attachment: pricing-slate_v1).
- Coordinate hubspot deal updates (DEAL-2027-0893).

If Olga or Karthik need signoffs from Product for trade-offs, ping me and I’ll loop in the right exec.

Marissa
Senior Sales Director
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@nimbushealth.com>, Anna Lee <anna@nimhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sherpa sync: lift plan for exec asks + roadmap exception closes

Thanks — I started a compliance tracker and filled what Nimbus already sent (attached). Quick clarifications:
- They asked specifically about audit log retention: default hosted retention is 30 days; Nimbus is asking for 365 days.
  - Impact: storage and retrieval costs; Dedicated can be configured for longer retention but requires a policy doc and KMS key handling.
- SOC mapping: we can provide the SOC2 report and a mapped control matrix for the Dedicated environment, but it will require the private control plane checklist to be closed (I’ve listed outstanding items in the tracker).

Proposed near-term asks for this week:
1) Product/Infra decision: allow 365d retention for Nimbus on Dedicated (yes/no) — Karthik/Vivek please advise.
2) If yes, I’ll need a short escalation note to Security for KMS key provisioning and an owner's name for implementation (preferably Vivek).

Attachments: Nimbus_Security_Reqs_Summary.pdf (updated), compliance_tracker_nimbus.csv

Olga
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sherpa sync: lift plan for exec asks + roadmap exception closes

Looping back after infra sync — short answers and next steps:
- Dedicated model pin: feasible. We can guarantee a specific model artifact and freeze for Nimbus provided we queue a canary rollout window. Work needed: commit a model artifact ID and a rollout cutoff (I propose 2027-05-24 as the cutoff).
- Audit log retention 365d on Dedicated: feasible but requires NBD (non-blocking) infra work and KMS provisioning. Vivek, can you take ownership of the infra ticket? If yes, Olga can assign the security checklist to me for the product gating items.

Proposed schedule (tight):
- Tue 2027-05-17: Karthik publishes planned model artifact ID and freeze window.
- Wed 2027-05-18: Vivek opens infra ticket for retention + KMS (include cost estimate).
- Fri 2027-05-21: Marissa sends pricing terms to Nimbus (initial).

If any of these dates are impossible, flag immediately. I’ll also add the rollout plan to the Sherpa_Lift_Roadmap.xlsx in the Drive link.

Thanks — Karthik
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
